staticReview: N3 exact bookId/level and draft state checked; edition is canonical full-manuscript SHA prefix and includes provenance.
Asset paths reject absolute/parent/empty/prototype-property segments; evidence paths verify regular file and exact hash.
Three QA scopes require passed status plus exact bookId/edition/content/assets bundle identity and hashed evidence.
Packager uses validated bundle SHA and declared asset SHA before copy, checks temporary tree, preserves immutable edition and prior candidate IDs.
Ruby annotations and reading-note text are removed from sourceIndex; original manuscript text is separately compared to exact re-rendered HTML.
Runtime storage namespace is manabi-japanese-n3:<revision>:answers-v1 and saves local authored field IDs; no account or publication API.
No accidental 42-lesson/seven-step/N4 storage key remainder found in N3 producer files. Remaining N4 text describes prerequisite learning.
No tracked changes found in the six N4 producer files when compared with the shared repository base.

limitations: Synthetic full48 fixture repeats lesson1 and is not valid production manuscript or independent language acceptance.
Scratch QA receipts deliberately simulate flags to exercise integrity checks; receipts do not prove that real language/browser review happened.
Provenance and byte determinism were checked in this current local font/tool environment only; cross-platform generation was not tested.
The initial hash snapshot was captured after initial vulnerability probes and is not claimed as their exact source revision.

First extra-probe harness expected wording Regular entry instead of actual Regular file; corrected the scratch expectation and reran all five cases. No producer source change was made for this mismatch.
Whole actual N3 manuscript, actual standalone/app browser, normal operating login, TTS, publication and learning efficacy were not certified by this tooling review.
